method: Union of landcover.kind=glacier and landuse.kind=glacier polygons from world_z0_z7.pmtiles, rasterized into the snow climatology ±90 grid (row-major, north first) with even-odd scanline fill; the south polar cap beyond the tile source (-84.8°) is marked as ice-sheet domain.

output.encoding: u8, 0 or 255, row-major, row 0 = +90°, v = (90 - lat) / 180

source.file: world_z0_z7.pmtiles (game content/web/maps; absolute path configured server-side)

scope: Data support only. The shader still requires the snow climatology perennial signal; this mask only removes places the vector world says are not glacier/ice sheet.
